analysis.interval_note: mean +/- 1.96 * sample SD of the pair scores / sqrt(n); unadjusted for multiple comparisons; the pair is the independent unit.

config.record_layout: block = pairing index; winners.games = [winner seat of game 0, of game 1]; game 0 seats the first agent of the pairing first, game 1 second
config.settings: phase2: greedy, adapt=true, default weighted beliefs, profile_prior as recorded, encoder by input width; phase1: encoder v1, default sampling and profile; AU/Reactive: fixed initial state, fresh history; new policies every game and seat
